description: Tuning for the coffee production forecast. Every default here is a real agronomic assumption — change them rather than the code.

fields.label: Weeks From Flowering To Ripe
fields.description: Arabica typically ripens 30-35 weeks after flowering. This is what turns a flowering event into a harvest-week forecast — the single most important number on this page. Confirm with your agronomist for your altitude.

fields.label: Ripening Spread (Weeks)
fields.description: A flowering does not ripen on one day. The forecast spreads each event over this many weeks, peaking in the middle.

fields.label: Days Between Picking Rounds
fields.description: Selective picking interval. A block not picked within this many days is flagged overdue — overripe cherry drops and drags down the whole outturn.

fields.label: Average Cherry Weight (g)
fields.description: Used to turn berry counts into kilograms.

fields.label: Expected Fruit Drop %
fields.description: Share of counted berries that never reach the store: abscission, CBD, borer, stripping losses. Published Arabica figures run 10-40% under water stress and 24-30% where CBD is unchecked. A count that ignores it always over-promises.

fields.label: Cherry : Parchment
fields.description: Fallback only. Ratios measured from your own Outturn Statements are used whenever there is history for the block.

fields.label: Cherry Price per kg
fields.description: Used to value the forecast, so a delayed picking round can be shown in money rather than kilograms.

fields.label: Kg per Debe
fields.description: Converts the Planner's kg forecast into debes when saving a week as a Coffee Harvest Plan (expected_debes = forecast kg / this).

fields.label: Default Kg per Worker (per week)
fields.description: Farm-wide fallback used by the Planner tab to turn a block's revised forecast into a headcount, wherever a block/week does not set its own rate. Not a wage figure — see Picker Rate per kg for that.

fields.label: Wage Expense Account
fields.description: Debited, per block, by Coffee Payment when a picker is actually paid. Not used by Block Payment Request, which only authorizes — it never raises a Journal Entry itself.

fields.label: Wage Payable Account
fields.description: Credited by Coffee Payment for the amount actually paid out.

name: Coffee Production Settings
